newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH REAAL FINALISES UNIT SALE TO BELGIUM'S DVV.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH REAAL FINALISES UNIT SALE TO BELGIUM'S DVV.

text.p: Dutch unlisted insurer Reaal Groep NV said it had finalised the sale of its Belgian subsidiary Corona to Brussels-based DVV-Verzekeringen, which was first announced last July.
Corona is a so-called "direct writer" which does not use intermediaries to do business with its clients. It posts annual premium income of about 10 billion Belgian francs.

Reaal said it had sold the Brussels-based unit, of which it became owner in 1995 as part of another takeover, because it wanted to concentrate on the Dutch market. No financial details of the transaction were disclosed.
